requirementSections.title: Financial Aid Eligibility
notes: Students in the graduate colleges must meet all criteria to be eligible for federal financial aid including:

Additionally, to be eligible for federal financial aid you must be enrolled in at least 4 credits per term, unless you are on a co-op, clinical rotation, residency, or are enrolled in a full-time or half-time stand-alone course.
Students enrolled in graduate certificate programs are not eligible for federal financial aid.

While international students are not eligible for federal aid, other financing options are available. Please visit the Student Financial Services website to learn more about the resources available to international students.
